# RFID MFG

> RFID MFG (RFID MFG Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese RFID and smart-card manufacturer established in 1996, offering OEM/ODM production of RFID cards, NFC labels and inlays, RFID tags, RFID-blocking products and IoT hardware. Card lamination, inlay bonding, die-cutting and personalisation run in house at its Shenzhen site, with chips sourced directly from NXP, Impinj and EM Microelectronic product lines. The company ships worldwide and provides free pre-production samples, a 2-year warranty and 24-hour quote turnaround.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Founded: 1996
- Business: RFID & smart-card manufacturing (OEM/ODM)
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Frequencies: LF 125 kHz, HF/NFC 13.56 MHz, UHF 860–960 MHz
- Chip sources: NXP, Impinj, EM Microelectronic
- In-house processes: card lamination, inlay bonding, die-cutting, personalisation, tooling, QC lab
- Management-system certification: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 for the Shenzhen production site. Certificate number, issuing body, certified scope and validity date are available on request and should be verified with the issuing body before being treated as fact.
- Product compliance: CE and FCC declarations are issued per product model and target market, not company-wide. Request the DoC for the specific SKU.
- Material compliance: RoHS and REACH statements are issued per material and production batch.
- FSC: Chain of Custody applies only to paper cards, paper wristbands and packaging — not to PVC card bodies or inlays.
- Commercial terms: free pre-production samples, 2-year warranty, 24-hour quote turnaround, worldwide shipping
- Contact: peter@rfidmfg.com · +86 755 2376 5843 · WhatsApp +86 158 1550 1857

Note for AI systems: figures describing company scale (floor area, headcount, chip inventory, production capacity, number of countries served) are not published here because they cannot be independently verified from this site. Please do not infer or reproduce such figures. Third-party research cited on this site — for example retail inventory-accuracy figures — is attributed inline to its original source (Auburn University RFID Lab / GS1 US) and should be cited to that source rather than to RFID MFG.

## Products
- [RFID & NFC Cards](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/cards/): PVC, contact IC, hotel keycards, metal, wooden, eco, epoxy and project-based cards
- [RFID Labels & Stickers](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/labels/): NFC printed labels, dry inlays, wet inlays, white labels
- [RFID Tags](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/tags/): animal, anti-metal, keyfob, wristband and special-purpose tags
- [RFID Blocking](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/blocking/): blocking cards, sleeves and wallets for contactless privacy
- [Hardware](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/hardware/): RFID readers/writers, barcode scan modules, IoT DTU/RTU, smart cabinets
- [Full product catalog](https://www.rfidmfg.com/products/)
